title: Price table (P2.2)
description: Rates per model tier from factory.json 'price_table' (spec section 15: the kernel converts reported usage to cost using this table). Keys are tier names (typically a model id, plus the required fallback 'default'); each tier prices exactly the three metered metrics per one million tokens. A table with only 'default' prices every model consistently; a strictly-typed tier pins one model's rates.
